il_main_amphitheater.blurb: The Main Amphitheater is the signature wall of Cove Hollow, a short drive from Carbondale in the Pomona area of southern Illinois. It holds 19 routes, nearly all of them bolted, with a few trad lines and top-rope options. This is a hard-climbers wall: most routes fall between 5.12 and 5.13, with only a couple of 5.10 and 5.11 climbs and one at the very top of the scale. The face is steep and overhanging, with a big roof, and a waterfall pours beside it, so it tends to stay damp after rain. Every route begins on the left side from a shared boulder problem. Expect a short stroll from the parking area, and a fire ring below the wall that sees plenty of use.

il_q_illuminati_boulders.blurb: Illuminati Boulders is one of the busier sectors of the Holy Boulders, the large sandstone bouldering zone near Pomona in the Shawnee National Forest country of southern Illinois. It has 19 problems and covers a wide range: a handful of moderate lines in the V2 to V6 range, a cluster of V7 and V8 problems, and a few serious test pieces up to V13. The sector is straightforward to locate by trail from the Mollusk boulder and is roomy enough for a full day. Standouts include a juggy, sloping arete at the lower end of the hard grades and a popular undercling line. The Holy Boulders are best visited in the cooler months, roughly October through early April.

il_j_railroad_rock_cliffline.blurb: Railroad Rock Cliffline is the wall running behind the freestanding Railroad Rock tower, in the North Canyon end of Jackson Falls in Shawnee National Forest, southern Illinois. It has 19 routes, roughly two-thirds bolted and the rest trad, with a top-rope option. Grades are spread widely, from a few 5.7 and 5.8 climbs through the 5.10s to a hard end that tops out in the low 5.13s, with 5.12 being the most common range. Easier lines make it more varied than neighbouring walls that are all hard sport. You reach it via the Railroad Rock approach, which is longer than most at Jackson Falls. It is also known as the Railroad Rock Back Wall.
